Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position in Barcelona. With over a year of hands-on experience in digital marketing and a strong technical foundation in SEO, content, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to help clients grow their businesses through innovative online marketing solutions.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites for clients. I also track performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. My own project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement structured data and optimize for AI-driven search, which aligns with the forward-thinking approach of your team.

I am a native Turkish speaker with professional English (B2+) and Dutch at B1, and I am actively improving my Dutch. I am goal-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn. I am ready to relocate to Barcelona and would love to bring my skills to your international team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your clients' success.

Best regards,
